notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted rows give issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS lists Class A (GOOGL) and Class C (GOOG) separately; Alphabet's classes have equal economic rights, so both are summed and divided by all three classes from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (October 21, 2026, rounded to millions), the same counts used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: Class A (GOOGL) only; the 10-K also gives 1,611 holders of record of Class C and approximately 57 of Class B.
